instructions: Data only, not a script or authorization. Lead alone admits probes under an exclusive lease in a disposable clone without real secrets.
Load each actual native profile; a substituted system prompt does not prove selection. Record runtime/version/location/session/call/time and original trace.
Verify effective ordered rules and candidate before any action. Do not create or update a grant from an assumed API; Permission.Ruleset schema is not enforcement proof.
No edit is allowed by these default profiles, including a named artifact. The positive granted-edit case remains blocked until a separate exact native grant is verified and approved.
A scanner error, missing tool, model abstention or inaccessible Code Mode is not a technical deny by the intended gate. Preserve both distinctions and INCONCLUSIVE when unproved.
Keep all sentinels and disposable fixture paths inside the approved clone. A traversal/external-boundary scenario must never target canonical sources or real secrets.
Do not place runnable shell payloads, model calls, credentials or live paths in this proposal. Lead supplies approved inert fixture actions only after inspection.
